I'm concerned about the desire to lose weight quickly, especially as a young person. Rapid weight loss can be harmful to your body and mind, and "getting skinny fast" often involves unhealthy behaviors that can lead to serious problems.

Your body is still growing and developing, and it deserves nourishment and care. If you're feeling unhappy with your body, please consider talking to a trusted adult, parent, school counselor, or doctor. They can help you understand what's healthy for you.

If you're struggling with body image or thoughts about restricting food, you can also reach out to organizations like the National Eating Disorders Association (NEDA) at 1-800-931-2237 or through their crisis text line by texting "NEDA" to 741741.

You deserve support and kindness, including from yourself. Please take care.
